instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-20_input.step. Build a single fused fixture from the 230 x 140 x 18 mm base plate. Add two 40 x 32 x 28 mm support blocks centered at (75,80) and (155,80), with bottoms on Z=18, and chamfer each support block top outside edge by 4 mm before or after fusing. Cut a diameter 14 mm vertical through hole through each support and the base at (75,80) and (155,80). Cut four base mounting holes of diameter 7 mm at (20,20), (210,20), (20,120), and (210,120). Cut a shallow rectangular top pocket in the base spanning X=85..145, Y=30..58, and Z=12..18. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-20_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
